rounds.text: Crestchem Ltd trades at a modest P/E of 14.8 [E1] while delivering extraordinary capital efficiency, highlighted by a stellar ROCE of 43.4% [E6] and a 3-year median ROE of 41% [E22]. The business is conservatively financed with zero debt [E32], generating robust operational cash flows that fully back reported profits with a 1.32x cash conversion ratio [E28]. Furthermore, the company operates within a strongly supportive chemical sector tailwind [E64] and boasts compounding historical momentum, including a 10-year sales growth rate of 72% [E8] alongside rising quarterly operating margins [E27]. Conceded: Promoter holding is low at 29.76% and has declined slightly over recent periods [E35], and debtor days have increased to 44.8 days [E56].
